shortDescription: Gets the supported browsers and their versions

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: browser_type
options.description: Return only the entry matching a specific browser type. If not set, all supported browsers are returned.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: older_versions
options.description: Return only browser entries whose C(older_versions) list contains at least one of the supplied values. The returned C(older_versions) list is narrowed to only the matched values, and C(versions) is returned empty unless also searched.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: query
options.description: An optional JMESPath expression applied locally to the (already filtered) list of browser entries. Use this for advanced filtering/projection that the simple key filters cannot express. See U(https://jmespath.org/) for the expression syntax. Each entry exposes the keys C(browser_type), C(versions) and C(older_versions).

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: versions
options.description: Return only browser entries whose C(versions) list contains at least one of the supplied values. The returned C(versions) list is narrowed to only the matched values, and C(older_versions) is returned empty unless also searched.
